messages.plaintextBody: Join our autumn Real Estate update covering the minimum energy efficiency standards (MEES), the proposed 2027 and 2030 EPC thresholds and what they mean for landlords' lease drafting. Lunch provided. 1 hour CPD. RSVP to Learning.
